contract.dynamic_registration: A listener registered during event delivery becomes eligible for the active delivery sequence
contract.delivery_order: The newly registered listener is delivered after listeners already present in the registry
contract.current_event_delivery: A listener registered before the delivery loop reaches it receives the current event
contract.registry_update: Registration during emit immediately updates the listener registry
contract.duplicate_prevention: Repeated registration of the same callback and plugin does not create duplicate listener entries
contract.subsequent_delivery: The dynamically registered listener remains available for subsequent events
contract.emit_success: EventBus.emit() remains successful when a listener registers another listener during delivery
contract.permission_enforcement: Registration and event emission require the appropriate events permission
